title: Human-Nature Conflicts
description: What are we doing to our planet? We have profound impacts on our species, other species, and our shared environment. In 'Human and Nature Conflicts', we explore the relationships between humanity and the natural world through the lens of socio-economic disparities around the globe. We will investigate human-nature conflicts, from environmental ethics to the pursuit of environmental justice and consider issues that shape them. We will also engage in debate, collaborate on group projects, and unleash our critical thinking skills as we grapple with some of the big questions of our time. Using an interdisciplinary approach that draws on insights from the social and natural sciences, this course aims to equip students with the knowledge and analytical skills necessary to engage with pressing environmental challenges and work towards more sustainable and just societies.
